# Onboarding process

<a id="flow_p01"></a>
## Onboarding

Collect details and check completeness. Complete details lead to access preparation and completion; an incomplete submission leads to a request and then ends this attempt. Evidence: [src_p01], [src_p02], [src_p03], [src_p04], [src_p05], [src_p90].

Collect employee details. Evidence: [src_p01].
